summary: Implemented the open/wrap_file reading feature in rich/progress.py (private _FileReader and _ReadContext, module-level open and wrap_file, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file), added 14 tests to tests/test_progress.py, added docs subsections to docs/source/progress.rst, and added one changelog entry. All changes are additive and uncommitted. Tests, mypy, and black were not run, since I was told not to execute repository code, so everything was verified by reading only. Known gaps: Progress.open leaves an orphan task if the file open fails after the task is created (spec ordering); _FileReader.readinto may be flagged by type checkers because BinaryIO has no readinto; the reader defines mode and name properties for Python 3.6 abstract-property enforcement; mode 'tr' returns a binary reader per the spec's exact-match rule.
